scan.title: Scan cards
scan.intro: Upload photos or scans of cards. Each image is matched against the selected game's catalog on the server; review the matches, correct any that are wrong, then add them to a location.

controls.seedHint: Game / sets / condition / foil above seed each new scan; edit any card (or several at once) below before committing.

commit.addedNote: Only confirmed & checked scans are added.
commit.addedNoteFiltered: Only confirmed & checked scans are added, and only those shown by the current filter.

audit.title: Audit: {{location}}
audit.banner: Scan every card physically in this location, confirm the matches, then commit. Committing makes this scan the source of truth for the location: matched cards are kept, cards not scanned are removed, and new cards are added.
audit.commitHint: Only confirmed & checked scans count toward the audit.

summary.title: Audit complete: {{location}}
summary.updated: Overwrote condition/foil on {{count}} matched card(s) from the scan.
summary.matchedEmpty: No cards matched what was already here.
summary.notFoundEmpty: Every card previously here was found.

master.noMatchFilter: No scans match the current filter.

detail.noConfidentMatch: No confident match. Use “Search catalog” to pick the correct card, or “View scan” to read it.
detail.selectPrompt: Select a scanned card to review it.

correction.searchingAllSets: Searching all sets — pick “Sets (art fallback)” above to narrow.

bulk.help: Tick a property to apply it to every checked card. Unticked properties are left unchanged.

value.newTooltip: New — not in your collection yet

listReprint.label: The List
listReprint.tooltip: The List (plst) reprint — an official, cheaper printing. Matched to the plst printing.
listReprint.unresolvedTooltip: Detected as a The List reprint, but its plst printing wasn't found in the catalog — the printing and price shown may be the more expensive original. Check before adding.
